name: S6
description: The Audi S6 (1994–present) is the performance version of the A6, combining executive saloon practicality with enhanced performance. Key generations include the C5 (quattroed 4.2-litre V8) and the current C8 with a 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 MHEV.
